meta_description: Lemon Grass delivers expert landscape gardening across Manchester. Award-winning design, professional planting, and garden maintenance. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Landscape Gardeners — Abbey Hey & Beyond
hero_subhead: From overgrown mess to stunning outdoor space. We design, build, and maintain gardens that work for your family and your budget.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: Whether you need a full garden redesign, professional planting, or regular maintenance, we handle every aspect of outdoor space creation and upkeep.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs that suit your space, style, and lifestyle. We produce detailed plans so you know exactly what you're getting before any work begins.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, decking, raised beds, pathways, and retaining walls built to last. All materials laid to professional standards with proper drainage and foundations.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection and placement for year-round colour and structure. We source quality plants and establish them properly so they thrive in your garden.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal cleanup. We keep your garden looking its best with flexible monthly or quarterly visits.

services.title: Clearance & Makeover
services.desc: Tackling overgrown gardens and complete overhauls. We clear, level, and prepare the ground, then rebuild your space from scratch.

services.title: Specialist Features
services.desc: Water features, lighting, planting borders, and bespoke garden structures. Custom additions that add real value and enjoyment to your outdoor space.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We just help you write a better one.
about_para_1: Lemon Grass was established in 2006 by two landscape gardeners fed up with rushed, impersonal work. For nearly two decades, we've designed and built gardens across Manchester—from small urban terraces to large country gardens. Each project starts with a proper consultation, a clear plan, and a realistic timeline so you're never surprised.
about_para_2: We're known locally for hands-on service, attention to detail, and honest pricing. Half our work comes from repeat customers and referrals, which tells you everything about how seriously we treat every garden. We don't cut corners, and we don't use cowboy subcontractors—it's us, doing the work.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Lemon Grass

reviews.text: Had a completely overgrown garden that we didn't know where to start. These lads came in, designed something we actually loved, and transformed it in a week. Professional, tidy, fair price. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Lemon Grass for maintenance every month now for two years. They're reliable, always turn up on time, and actually care about how the garden looks. Dead rare to find that level of service.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Brilliant from start to finish. The designer spent proper time with us understanding what we wanted, the team were respectful and worked hard, and the finish is immaculate. Genuinely couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: David M.
